20inline uint64_t htonll(uint64_t x)
21{
22 return ((1 == htonl(1)) ? (x) : ((uint64_t)htonl((x)&0xFFFFFFFF) << 32) | htonl((x) >> 32));
23}

37inline void tlvf_swap(uint8_t size, uint8_t *ptr)
38{
39 switch (size) {
40 case 16: {
41 uint16_t *tmp16 = reinterpret_cast<uint16_t *>(ptr);
42 swap_16(*tmp16);
43 break;
44 }
45 case 32: {
46 uint32_t *tmp32 = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(ptr);
47 swap_32(*tmp32);
48 break;
49 }
50 case 64: {
51 uint64_t *tmp64 = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t *>(ptr);
52 swap_64(*tmp64);
53 break;
54 }
55 default:
56 break;
57 }
58}
